scriptOverride.reason: Condition needs this.game.getConflicts(opponent).filter(!passed).length > 1 - a count of the opponent's remaining conflict declarations this phase, a conflict-collection query beyond compareValues/anyCardMatches (which operate over cards, not the round's conflict record).
